Caterpillar Del (CAT) Holder Ashfield Capital Partners Has Increased Its Holding; Seaboard (SEB) Holder Kahn Brothers Group Has Lowered Holding by $220.50 Million as Market Valuation Declined
May 16, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Ashfield Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Caterpillar Inc Del (CAT) by 16.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ashfield Capital Partners Llc bought 8,678 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.62% with the market. The institutional investor held 61,374 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.67 million, up from 52,696 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ashfield Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Caterpillar Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $91.89 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $1.1 during the last trading session, reaching $153.69. About 1.48M shares traded. Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) has risen 60.63% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.08% the S&P500.
Irving Kahn decreased its stake in Seaboard Corp (SEB) by 0.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kahn Brothers Group Inc sold 50 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.09% with the market. The hedge fund run by Irving Kahn held 7,839 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.57 billion, down from 7,889 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kahn Brothers Group Inc who had been investing in Seaboard Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.65 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $12.96 during the last trading session, reaching $3970. About 78 shares traded. Seaboard Corporation (NYSEMKT:SEB) has risen 6.93% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.62% the S&P500.
Among 35 analysts covering Caterpillar Inc. ( NYSE:CAT ), 18 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 13 Hold. Therefore 51% are positive. Caterpillar Inc. had 136 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was upgraded on Friday, January 27 by Wells Fargo. As per Friday, January 26, the company rating was maintained by UBS. The firm has “Hold” rating by Robert W. Baird given on Friday, January 12. The rating was upgraded by Barclays Capital to “Overweight” on Tuesday, February 7. The company was maintained on Friday, January 26 by Bank of America. Citigroup maintained Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) rating on Friday, March 18. Citigroup has “Neutral” rating and $75 target. The company was maintained on Thursday, January 18 by Jefferies. The rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs on Tuesday, October 11 to “Buy”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, January 5 by UBS. The stock of Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) earned “Buy” rating by Argus Research on Tuesday, April 26.
Ashfield Capital Partners Llc, which manages about $2.94 billion and $777.43M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Cognizant Technology Solutio (NASDAQ:CTSH) by 4,370 shares to 22,613 shares, valued at $1.61M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Analog Devices Inc (NASDAQ:ADI) by 4,727 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 105,417 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
